// TEMPORARY (feat/4.1.0-desktop only, remove before merge).
// Copied to example/lib/desktop_runtime_proof_main.dart by
// .github/workflows/TEMP-windows-crt-proof.yml and built in release mode.
//
// Usage: example.exe <interpreter|compiled> <output file>
// Runs one engine on simple_model (y = 2x + 1) on CPU, writes a log to the
// output file and exits 0 on success, 1 on failure. For the Interpreter it
// also records which modules the process loaded while bringing up
// libtensorflowlite_c-win.dll (4 threads, XNNPack, so pthreadpool starts C11
// threads).
import 'dart:ffi';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:ffi/ffi.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:flutter_litert/native.dart';

final _log = StringBuffer();

void log(String s) => _log.writeln(s);

typedef _EnumNative =
    Int32 Function(IntPtr, Pointer<IntPtr>, Uint32, Pointer<Uint32>);
typedef _EnumDart = int Function(int, Pointer<IntPtr>, int, Pointer<Uint32>);
typedef _NameNative = Uint32 Function(IntPtr, Pointer<Utf16>, Uint32);
typedef _NameDart = int Function(int, Pointer<Utf16>, int);
typedef _CurNative = IntPtr Function();
typedef _CurDart = int Function();

List<String> loadedModules() {
  final k32 = DynamicLibrary.open('kernel32.dll');
  final enumMods = k32.lookupFunction<_EnumNative, _EnumDart>(
    'K32EnumProcessModules',
  );
  final getName = k32.lookupFunction<_NameNative, _NameDart>(
    'GetModuleFileNameW',
  );
  final cur = k32.lookupFunction<_CurNative, _CurDart>('GetCurrentProcess');
  const cap = 2048;
  final mods = calloc<IntPtr>(cap);
  final needed = calloc<Uint32>();
  final name = calloc<Uint16>(1024).cast<Utf16>();
  try {
    if (enumMods(cur(), mods, cap * sizeOf<IntPtr>(), needed) == 0) {
      return ['<K32EnumProcessModules failed>'];
    }
    final n = needed.value ~/ sizeOf<IntPtr>();
    final out = <String>[];
    for (var i = 0; i < n && i < cap; i++) {
      final len = getName(mods[i], name, 1024);
      out.add(name.toDartString(length: len));
    }
    return out;
  } finally {
    calloc.free(mods);
    calloc.free(needed);
    calloc.free(name);
  }
}

String base(String p) => p.split(RegExp(r'[\\/]')).last.toLowerCase();

Future<bool> runInterpreter(Uint8List model, Uint8List seg) async {
  final before = loadedModules().toSet();
  final options = InterpreterOptions()..threads = 4;
  final xnn = XNNPackDelegate(options: XNNPackDelegateOptions(numThreads: 4));
  options.addDelegate(xnn);
  final interpreter = Interpreter.fromBuffer(model, options: options);
  interpreter.getInputTensor(0).asFloat32View()[0] = 3.0;
  interpreter.invoke();
  final y = interpreter.getOutputTensor(0).asFloat32View()[0];
  log('Interpreter version: ${Interpreter.version}');
  log('Interpreter simple_model(3.0) = $y (expected 7.0)');
  // A real network on 4 threads, so the XNNPack thread pool does real work.
  final segOptions = InterpreterOptions()..threads = 4;
  final segInterp = Interpreter.fromBuffer(seg, options: segOptions);
  final input = segInterp.getInputTensor(0).asFloat32View();
  for (var i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    input[i] = (i % 255) / 255.0;
  }
  segInterp.invoke();
  final out = segInterp.getOutputTensor(0).asFloat32View();
  var finite = true;
  for (final v in out) {
    if (!v.isFinite) finite = false;
  }
  log('Interpreter selfie_multiclass 4 threads: ${out.length} outputs, all finite: $finite');
  final after = loadedModules();
  final added = after.where((m) => !before.contains(m)).toList();
  log('modules loaded by bringing up the Interpreter (${added.length}):');
  for (final m in added) {
    log('  + $m');
  }
  log('all modules in process (${after.length}):');
  for (final m in after) {
    log('  $m');
  }
  final threadsLoaded = after.any(
    (m) => base(m) == 'vcruntime140_threads.dll',
  );
  final vcAdded = added.where(
    (m) => RegExp(r'^(vcruntime|msvcp|ucrtbase|api-ms-win-crt)').hasMatch(base(m)),
  );
  log('vcruntime140_threads.dll loaded in process: $threadsLoaded');
  log('VC++/UCRT modules added by the Interpreter: ${vcAdded.isEmpty ? '(none)' : vcAdded.join(', ')}');
  final tflite = after.where((m) => base(m) == 'libtensorflowlite_c-win.dll');
  log('libtensorflowlite_c-win.dll loaded from: ${tflite.join(', ')}');
  segInterp.close();
  interpreter.close();
  xnn.delete();
  final ok = (y - 7.0).abs() < 1e-3 && finite && !threadsLoaded && vcAdded.isEmpty;
  return ok;
}

Future<bool> runCompiled(Uint8List model) async {
  final execDir = File(Platform.resolvedExecutable).parent.path;
  final direct = '$execDir\\libLiteRt.dll';
  try {
    DynamicLibrary.open(direct);
    log('DynamicLibrary.open($direct): OK');
  } catch (e) {
    log('DynamicLibrary.open($direct) FAILED: $e');
  }
  final cm = CompiledModel.fromBuffer(model, accelerators: {Accelerator.cpu});
  final input = Float32List(cm.inputByteSizes[0] ~/ 4);
  input[0] = 3.0;
  final y = cm.run([input])[0][0];
  log('CompiledModel CPU simple_model(3.0) = $y (expected 7.0)');
  cm.close();
  final mods = loadedModules();
  log('libLiteRt.dll loaded from: ${mods.where((m) => base(m) == 'liblitert.dll').join(', ')}');
  log('vcruntime140_threads.dll loaded from: ${mods.where((m) => base(m) == 'vcruntime140_threads.dll').join(', ')}');
  return (y - 7.0).abs() < 1e-3;
}

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final mode = args.isNotEmpty ? args[0] : 'interpreter';
  final outPath = args.length > 1 ? args[1] : 'proof-$mode.txt';
  var ok = false;
  try {
    log('mode: $mode');
    log('executable: ${Platform.resolvedExecutable}');
    log('cwd: ${Directory.current.path}');
    final model = (await rootBundle.load(
      'assets/simple_model.tflite',
    )).buffer.asUint8List();
    if (mode == 'interpreter') {
      final seg = (await rootBundle.load(
        'assets/selfie_multiclass.tflite',
      )).buffer.asUint8List();
      ok = await runInterpreter(model, seg);
    } else if (mode == 'compiled') {
      ok = await runCompiled(model);
    } else {
      log('unknown mode $mode');
    }
  } catch (e, st) {
    log('EXCEPTION: $e');
    log('$st');
    ok = false;
  }
  log(ok ? 'RESULT: PASS' : 'RESULT: FAIL');
  File(outPath).writeAsStringSync(_log.toString());
  exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
}
